meta.title: Kapturae | Free online photobooth
meta.description: Free photobooth in your browser. Pick a frame, take a few shots, add stickers or filters, and save it as a photo or GIF.

hero.sub: A photobooth that runs in your browser. Pick a frame, strike a few poses, and download a strip or a GIF.
hero.keep: Results kept 24 hours · Reopen via QR · Then deleted

flow.label: How it works
flow.title: 4 steps.
flow.description: Frame, shoot, edit, save. Nothing to install.

frame.title: Pick a frame
frame.body: Classic strip, 2×2 grid, polaroid, and a few more.

shoot.title: Shoot
shoot.body: Camera on, 3·2·1, snap. One shot per slot.

edit.title: Edit
edit.body: Filters, stickers, text, doodles. Don't like one? Retake just that one.

download.title: Download
download.body: Save it as a photo or GIF, or scan the QR to open it again. The link lasts 24 hours, then it's deleted.

frames.label: Frames
frames.title: Pick your frame
frames.description: The frame sets how many shots you take and how they're laid out.

editor.label: Editor
editor.title: Edit your photos.
editor.description: Someone blinked? Retake that one slot. The rest of your photos and edits stay put.
editor.retake_hint:
Camera comes back on,
other slots stay as they are

gif.label: GIF
gif.title: Why stop at photos?
gif.description: Every shot from your session, stitched into one looping GIF.

data.label: Data & privacy
data.title: Kept for 24 hours.
data.description: We store your session results on our server for a while so you can reopen them with a QR code. Once 24 hours pass, every file is permanently deleted.

uploaded.title: Results uploaded
uploaded.body: Your photos and GIF are stored, and a QR code and private link are made for your session.

active.title: Reopen via QR
active.body: Scan the QR or open the link on any device to view and download your results again.

deleted.title: Gone for good
deleted.body: Files are deleted from the server and the link expires. They can't be recovered.

early.title: Delete sooner
early.body: Don't want to wait? Press Delete now on the results page.

save.title: Download before it ends
save.body: After 24 hours no copy is left. Save anything you want to keep first.

qr.title: Keep your QR safe
qr.body: Anyone with the QR or link can open your results while it's active.

cta.label: Start
cta.needs_value: A camera and a browser. That's it.

not_found.title: This frame is empty.
not_found.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist. The link may have a typo, or the content has moved.

server.title: Something's jammed.
server.body: The problem is on our side, not yours. Your current session isn't lost as long as this tab stays open. Try again in a moment.

gone.title: This link has expired.
gone.body: Result links only last 24 hours. That time has passed, so every file has been permanently deleted and can't be recovered.
